instruction.text: Which sentence has used the correct place conjunction?

b: ++Where the primary school is at its tallest, you can see the park.
Since the primary school is at its tallest, you can see the park.
Once the primary school is at its tallest, you can see the park.
++Alma wants to sit wherever Sophia is in the classroom.
Alma wants to sit as Sophia is in the classroom.
Alma wants to sit before Sophia is in the classroom.
++Remy wants to go somewhere where the sun is shining.
Remy wants to go somewhere there the sun is shining.
Remy wants to go somewhere before the sun is shining.

instruction.text: Which sentence has used the correct place adverb?

b: ++We looked around for new clothes.
We looked at for new clothes.
We looked that for new clothes.
++Tanya had nowhere to go after she got locked out.
Tanya had everywhere to go after she got locked out.
Tanya had there to go after she got locked out.
++Gail is going back to university this year.
Gail is going beyond to university this year.
Gail is going once to university this year.

instruction.text: Which sentence has used the correct place preposition?

b: ++Jamie got off the bus at the wrong stop.
Jamie got next to the bus at the wrong stop.
Jamie got since the bus at the wrong stop.
++Liam went to a concert in London this past weekend.
Liam went to a concert on London this past weekend.
Liam went to a concert during London this past weekend.
++Jamal couldn’t find anything he liked on the menu.
Jamal couldn’t find anything he liked opposite the menu.
Jamal couldn’t find anything he liked while the menu.
